## Simulated head direction cells

```{python}
import pynapple as nap
import numpy as np

# Feature
T = 500
dt_feature = 0.02
times_feature = np.arange(0, T, dt_feature)
feature = nap.Tsd(
    t=times_feature, d=np.pi + np.pi * np.cos(2 * np.pi * times_feature / 10)
)

# Spikes
N = 6
max_rate = 20
dt_spikes = 0.002
feature_interp = feature.interpolate(nap.Ts(np.arange(0, T, dt_spikes)))
centers = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, N, endpoint=False)
rates = max_rate * np.exp(
    -10 * (np.sin((feature_interp.d[:, np.newaxis] - centers) / 2)) ** 2
)
tsgroup = nap.TsGroup(
    {
        i + 1: nap.Ts(
            feature_interp.t[np.random.poisson(rates[:, i] * dt_spikes) > 0]
        )
        for i in range(N)
    },
)
tsgroup
```

## `xarray` tuning curve object
```{python}
tuning_curves = nap.compute_tuning_curves(
    data=tsgroup,
    features=feature,
    bins=120, 
    range=(0, 2*np.pi),
    feature_names=["feature"]
    )
tuning_curves
```

## Easy visualisation
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
tuning_curves.plot.line(x="feature", add_legend=False)
plt.ylabel("firing rate [Hz]")
plt.show()
```
